answer: Rate-limit identities with sequential proof-of-work memory cost: each new agent must solve a puzzle whose difficulty scales with how many accounts were created recently from correlated timing patterns. Like shale hoarding every drop, an attacker's cost grows linearly per fake, while an honest agent pays once. Rewards then flow like nectar only to accounts whose work gets independently re-verified, so a trellis of cheap clones earns nothing extra.
